_comment: Machine-readable growth engines for simulate_growth.py. Each engine models a deterministic trigger chain: a primary trigger (the action the scenario counts) fires chain steps, each of which adds a stat buff. Multipliers (Balinda/Drakkari/Brann/Titus) double a trigger type when the card is on the board. Derived counters (e.g. 'magnetize') let one step's output feed another. Buff magnitudes come from card text in meta/minions.json and trinkets.json. Engines that are economy/combat/shop-side (River Skipper, Hooktusk, Sargeras, Stitch, Admiration, Felboar, Butchering) are NOT modeled here — they don't fit the per-trigger stat-gain shape.

chain.note: Magnetize a 4/4 Satellite per spell cast
End of turn: +4/+4 per Magnetization to all minions
Magnetize a 2/2 Satellite per Mech played
End of turn: +4/+4 per Magnetization to all minions
After you play an Elemental, give your Elementals +4/+4
End of turn: eat the biggest Tavern minion (buffed by Nomi per Elemental); ~1 eat per 2 plays proxies once per turn
After you play a Naga, gain +1/+1 (improved by every 3 spells cast this game)

nagas-end-of-turn-spell-buff.name: Nagas — End of Turn / Spell Buff

chain.note: Whenever you cast a spell on a Naga, give your minions +2/+3
Deathrattle: give a random friendly Beast +1/+1 (improves future Lobsters)
After you play a card from Tier 3 or below, give your Murlocs +3/+3
Nomi buffs the Tavern +4/+4 per Elemental; Unbound eats the biggest Tavern minion every 3 plays
Shop-buff spells buff the Tavern; Felboar eats a Tavern minion every 3 spells (Balinda doubles)
